title: Rumer Willis talks genetic test after father's dementia diagnosis
seoTitle: Rumer Willis on Genetic Testing After Dad's Dementia
subtitle: The actress explains how her family situation led her to seek more information about health
excerpt: Actress Rumer Willis, daughter of Bruce Willis and Demi Moore, shared in a video that her father's dementia diagnosis motivated her to take an APOE genetic test.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: USA Today, The Times of India
contentHtml:
In a video published on August 24, Rumer Willis revealed that her father Bruce Willis's dementia diagnosis made her rethink her own health and led her to take a genetic test. The 38-year-old actress explained that the process was motivated by family concern over the genetic inheritance of neurodegenerative diseases.

What changed in Rumer Willis's life

Rumer Willis said that after Bruce Willis's frontotemporal dementia diagnosis, she realized that “there are genetic things in my family.” To better understand the risks, she opted to test for the APOE gene, which can indicate a predisposition to Alzheimer's disease. She stated that the result was “a three-four, which is medium,” but that this helped her gain control over her health.

How the genetic test helps monitor health

The actress highlighted that the genetic test gave her “power” by allowing her to work proactively to reduce inflammation, take care of cardiovascular health, and implement other preventive measures. She also stated that having detailed data facilitates more informed conversations with healthcare professionals, keeping them from being “gaslighted” about what is happening.

Bruce Willis's frontotemporal dementia diagnosis

In February 2023, Bruce Willis's family revealed that his initial condition of aphasia had progressed to frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The disease affects areas of the brain associated with personality, behavior, and language. Bruce Willis, 71, had stepped away from acting the previous year due to health issues.

Prevention and family care

Rumer Willis also pointed out that health is something often underestimated until it is no longer available. She states that by taking preventive measures now, she can avoid a “sharp decline” as she gets older. The actress emphasized that information about genetic risk is an important factor in planning future care.

How the family continues to deal with the condition

Bruce Willis's family continues to share updates on their father's condition and to raise awareness about dementia. Disseminating information about the evolution of the condition and seeking support demonstrate the importance of keeping the community informed and involved.
